title: WaterColor Condo Rental | Nearby Major WaterColor Amenities – Dune Vacation Rentals
meta_description: 6 WaterColor Blvd, #202 in WaterColor is a condo rental located nearby most of the amenities available in WaterColor! Shopping, dining, and most importantly, the beach! Book this wonderful WaterColor rental home and enjoy your Florida beach vacation!
description_expanded:
6 WaterColor Boulevard S, #202 is all about location! The convenience of being steps away from the beach club, beach, shops and eateries will help you make the best of your beach stay. This comfortable condo provides everything you could need for you and your family.

The natural light from the transom windows of the entry greet you as you first walk in. The hardwood floors and warm wood tones of the furnishings make you feel right at home. Cool blues, greens and grays meld well with the natural earthy tones throughout. The open concept kitchen, dining and living space allows you to stay connected with your guests during your getaway. The full kitchen will provide you all you'll need for dining - when not partaking in one of the many restaurants within walking distance. The dining space allow for either a quick bite to eat or a full meal to be shared. The covered balcony overlooking the heart of WaterColor is the perfect spot for an early morning coffee while watching the sunrise.

On the second floor of the condo (the third floor of the building), the master bedroom with its king sized bed and ensuite bathroom is perfect for relaxing after a day exploring WaterColor and the beautiful beaches. The private balcony off the master bedroom is a wonderful spot to start and end your day. The second floor of the condo also hosts the guest bedroom with two queen sized beds. The ensuite bathroom with a shower provides your guests everything they'll need. This WaterColor central condo is ideal for those that want to be steps away from the beach, the pool and all the happenings in WaterColor. Experience your WaterColor holiday while not having to worry about loading up your vehicle to head to the beach.

**Please note there is no elevator in the building

**********************************************************************

Home Highlights:

Sleeps 6

2 Bedrooms

2 Full Baths and 1 Half Bath

1,606 square feet

Spacious Balcony

Beach District Location

2 Beach Cruiser Bicycles

Complimentary Trolley Rides via WaterColor Trolley App

6 Amenity Wristbands

Access to All WaterColor Community Swimming Pools - Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club

First Floor of Condo (Second Floor of Building)

- Open concept living, dining, and kitchen areas

- The dining room features a table with seating for 5.

- The kitchen is equipped with appliances and plenty of cabinet and counter space

- Balcony with views over the WaterColor Resort.

- Half bathroom

Second Floor of Condo (Third Floor of Building)

- Master bedroom with king sized bed, private balcony, and ensuite master bathroom with double vanities, separate tub and shower

- Guest bedroom with 2 queen sized beds and an ensuite bathroom with a shower

Additional

- Guests can enjoy complimentary rides anywhere in WaterColor using the on-demand WaterColor Trolley, available through the WaterColor Trolley app in your app store.

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- No pet home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the no pet policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional cleaning charges.

- Watercolor condos cannot rent golf carts.

- 6 Amenity Wristbands - Maximum. Extras are not available. Access to All WaterColor Community Swimming Pools - Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club.

- The HOA issues one parking pass per reservation. Guests are encouraged to park their vehicles in the driveway or garage of their rental home. They do not need a parking pass when their vehicle is parked on a private residential property.The HOA-issued parking pass is required to park a vehicle overnight on the common area parking pads.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 Cancellation Fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM.

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
